kami_essentials.skill.subtitle: %1$s, level %2$s
kami_essentials.skill.help.level.desc: Class XP comes from activities like mining, farming, fishing, fighting, trading, smelting and research. Vanilla experience never counts. Playing actively also gives a steady trickle of XP to everyone, even without a class. A new level also needs enough active playtime, so leveling cannot be rushed. Each level gives a skill point, every tenth level one more.
kami_essentials.skill.help.tree.desc: Drag to move, scroll to zoom, double-click a lit node to take it. Wheels are constellations: own all seven nodes for a bonus. Cores come in pairs: take one and the other is blocked until you refund it. They have ranks that need a level and points spent in that class sector. The two keystones on the rim need many points in their sector, only one can be owned per class, and each has a drawback. You can own keystones in several classes, but every further one needs a higher level.
